en.title: Generating Scorekeeper Access Codes
en.excerpt: Creating, distributing, and managing 5-character access codes for line scorekeepers without personal user registration.
en.content:
5-Character Code Architecture

Archeris eliminates the bottleneck of requiring volunteer scorekeepers to create accounts and verify emails on the field. Organizers generate short, randomized 5-character alphanumeric codes (e.g., K8X2M) that grant immediate scoring rights for specific target butts.

Generating Event Access Codes

To generate scorekeeper codes:

  1. Open your tournament in the Organizer Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to the Scorekeepers tab.
  3. Click + Generate Scorekeeper Codes.
  4. Select whether to generate one master code for roaming judges or individual codes tied to specific target lanes.

Printing Scorekeeper Passes

Click Print Scorekeeper Lanyards to generate a printable sheet of badge inserts containing the event title, assigned target numbers, and large-font access codes.

Security & Code Revocation

Organizers can invalidate or regenerate access codes at any time from the dashboard if a tablet is misplaced or a scoring session concludes.
